{{Quote|And the shock troops were a waste. The Zongorlu are a ''plant species''. They're sentient, all right, but they're big and lumpy and they move about a meter a day. They kind of blinked when we landed.|Transmission by Koblus Sornell|<ref name="Interference" />}}
The '''Zongorlu''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zongorlu]]. They were large, slow-moving [[Plant/Legends|plants]]. During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was transmitting [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] from Zongorlu targeting the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]], the broadcasts made various false claims about the planet's inhabitants. According to the propaganda, the Zongorlu had a society organized into warrior-tribes and had withdrawn to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] after the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] had destroyed Zongorlu [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] vacation camps during their [[Battle of Serroco|attack]] on the planet [[Serroco]]. When a Neo-Crusader force later arrived on Zongorlu, the warriors encountered the native [[Alien/Legends|aliens]], discovering the truth about them.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|And if you've got to entertain yourselves, don't set fire to the Zongorlu. It hasn't rained all week. The whole camp could go up.|Transmission by Koblus Sornell to other Mandalorian Neo-Crusader soldiers|<ref name="Interference" />}}
The Zongorlu were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of large,<ref name="Interference" /> plump,<ref name="Jungle">{{SW|url=news/welcome-to-the-star-wars-jungle|text=Welcome to the ''Star Wars'' Jungle|int=Welcome to the Star Wars Jungle|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Plant/Legends|plants]] who moved across a distance of approximately one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] a [[Local day/Legends|day]].<ref name="Interference" /> The [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]]<ref name="War1">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 1|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 1]]</ref> [[Koblus Sornell]] described them as "lumpy" and noted that they "kind of blinked" when offworlders arrived on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Zongorlu]]. In arid conditions, the Zongorlu's bodies became [[Fire/Legends|flammable]].<ref name="Interference" />

==History==
===The tale...===
{{Quote|What you may not know is that those weren't all military camps on Serroco that Mandalore so callously and criminally nuked. There were vacation camps for Zongorlu younglings &mdash; nine camps, representing every major warrior-tribe on the planet!|Propaganda broadcast by "Captain Goodvalor"|<ref name="Interference" />}}
[[File:Zongorlu-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Zongorlu hailed from the planet of the same name (pictured on map).]]
The Zongorlu hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the same name,<ref name="Interference" /> located in the [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Serroco system/Legends|Serroco]], [[Taris system/Legends|Taris]], and [[Zongorlu system/Legends|Zongorlu systems]]</ref> In [[3963 BBY]], during the [[Mandalorian Wars|war]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]] faction of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture,<ref name="Interference" /> the [[Actor/Legends|actor]] [[Marn Hierogryph's brother|brother]] of the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] accidental Republic hero [[Marn Hierogryph]],<ref name="KOTOR47">[[Knights of the Old Republic 47|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 47]]</ref> the former of whom was performing the persona of "[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Benegryph Goodvalor|Goodvalor]]," transmitted a series of Republic [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] broadcasts aimed at Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] from a transmission station on Zongorlu. After it became known to "Goodvalor" that the Mandalorian occupation force on<ref name="Interference" /> the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] was going to also dispatch soldiers to Zongorlu, in his broadcasts the "captain" began making various false claims about the Zongorlu and their homeworld in order to try and dissuade the would-be invaders.<ref name="Interference" />

[[File:Nuclear_explosions.jpg|thumb|left|300px|"Captain Goodvalor" claimed that Zongorlu younglings' vacation camps had been destroyed during the Mandalorian nuclear attack on Serroco (pictured).]]
According to "Goodvalor," Zongorlu was a searingly [[Temperature/Legends|hot]], actively [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] world with an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] rich in [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfur]] and featuring constant [[Hurricane/Legends|hurricanes]]. The Zongorlu society was supposedly organized into warrior-tribes, with the species represented by a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the Republic's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]. "Goodvalor" further claimed that Zongorlu [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] had been present on<ref name="Interference" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC" /> planet<ref name="KOTOR15">[[Knights of the Old Republic 15|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 15]]</ref> [[Serroco]] in the form of nine vacation camps that represented each of the species' major warrior-tribes&mdash;camps that had been destroyed during the Mandalorians' [[Battle of Serroco|nuclear attack]] on that world.<ref name="Interference" />

At that point, the Zongorlu in "Goodvalor's" account had largely withdrawn from the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], becoming what the "captain" characterized as "stay-at-home types" as well as "more than a little touchy"&mdash;as exemplified by the Zongorlu senator, who had requested both a leave of absence and a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|heavy assault cannon]]. On Taris, after listening to "Goodvalor's" claims, a number of new Mandalorian soldiers came up to the signals expert Koblus Sornell&mdash;who had already grown annoyed by the propaganda broadcasts&mdash;inquiring as to the appearance and biology of the Zongorlu, leading to<ref name="Interference" /> her<ref name="War1" /> noting in a later transmission to soldiers that any such curiosity could be satisfied when the Mandalorians arrived at Zongorlu.<ref name="Interference" />

===...and the truth===
{{Quote|I don't think they had camps of younglings on Serroco &mdash; unless they had them out in the garden somewhere!|Transmission by Koblus Sornell|<ref name="Interference" />}}
[[File:Cassusfetthead.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Koblus Sornell informed Cassus Fett (pictured) about the true nature of the Zongorlu.]]
The Neo-Crusaders, including Sornell, eventually did travel to and land on Zongorlu. The surprised Devaronian subsequently sent a transmission to [[Cassus Fett]]<ref name="Interference" />&mdash;the aide-de-camp of the Mandalorian [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|leader]], [[Mandalore the Ultimate]]<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>&mdash;relaying to him the true nature of the Zongorlu as well as describing their reaction to the arriving Mandalorians. In the transmission, she also made a quip questioning the claim that Zongorlu younglings had been present on Serroco. Later, while the Neo-Crusaders on Zongorlu were awaiting their next orders from Fett, some of the bored soldiers began setting the local [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] on fire, a practice that Sornell then scolded in another transmission due to the risk of the dry weather causing the fire to spread to the Mandalorian camp.<ref name="Interference" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zongorlu were mentioned in "[[Interference]]," a [[2008]] short story written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and published on [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]].<ref name="Interference" />
